# Exqlite v0.38.0 - Table of Contents

> An Elixir SQLite3 library

## Pages

- [Readme](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Windows users](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/windows.md)
- [Changelog](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Exqlite](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.md): SQLite3 driver for Elixir.

- [Exqlite.Basic](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Basic.md): A very basic API for simple use cases.

- [Exqlite.Connection](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Connection.md): This module implements connection details as defined in DBProtocol.
- [Exqlite.Pragma](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Pragma.md): Handles parsing extra options for the SQLite connection

- [Exqlite.Query](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Query.md): Query struct returned from a successfully prepared query.

- [Exqlite.Result](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Result.md): The database results.

- [Exqlite.Sqlite3](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Sqlite3.md): The interface to the NIF implementation.

- [Exqlite.Sqlite3NIF](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Sqlite3NIF.md): This is the module where all of the NIF entry points reside. Calling this directly
should be avoided unless you are aware of what you are doing.

- [Exqlite.TypeExtension](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.TypeExtension.md): A behaviour that defines the API for extensions providing custom data loaders and dumpers
for Ecto schemas.

- Exceptions
  - [Exqlite.Error](https://exqlite.hexdocs.pm/Exqlite.Error.md): The error emitted from SQLite or a general error with the library.
